data: Dans le royaume de Letonia, le jeune prince Egon passe ses nuits à jouer de la batterie. Le jour, il n'a qu'une idée en tête : pénétrer le royaume de Kentz pour retrouver la belle dormant et briser le charme. Mais son père, le roi, qui ne croit pas aux contes de fées, y est totalement opposé. C'est Maggie Jerkins, archéologue de l'Unesco, qui va lui donner la clef. (In the Kingdom of Letonia, young Prince Egon spends his nights playing the drums. During the day, he's only got one thing on his mind: entering the Kingdom of Kentz to get together with the sleeping beauy and break the spell. But his father the kind, who does not believe in fairy tales, is totally against this. Maggie Jones, an UNESCO archeologist, will be the one who gives him the key.)

In the Kingdom of Letonia, young Prince Egon spends his nights playing the drums. During the day, he's only got one thing on his mind: entering the Kingdom of Kentz to get together with the sleeping beauy and break the spell. But his father the kind, who does not believe in fairy tales, is totally against this. Maggie Jones, an UNESCO archeologist, will be the one who gives him the key.
